# wdym

> A prompt rewriter for Claude Code that fires automatically on every prompt you submit, detects its type, and rewrites it using a handful of matched prompt-engineering principles.

wdym is a Claude Code skill plus a `UserPromptSubmit` hook. The hook (`prompt-detect.py`)
scores each prompt deterministically and — for substantive prompts — injects a
`<prompt-detect>` signal block; a trusted `CLAUDE.md` contract (written by `install.sh`)
tells the model to run the skill before answering. The skill
classifies the prompt (`code` / `question` / `text-gen` / `none`), loads only the
principle files that apply, and rewrites. To change behavior, start at `SKILL.md` (a thin
dispatcher) and follow it into `refs/protocol.md`. Most detail lives in `refs/*` and loads
lazily — the SKILL.md body is re-injected on every run, so it stays small on purpose.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/README.md): what it does, install, how it works, modes and flags
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/SKILL.md): the router — start here to modify behavior; dispatches into refs/
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): full flow diagram, file map, and design notes (token budget, caching, degrade-then-heal)

## Reference

- [refs/protocol.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/refs/protocol.md): step-by-step execution, Steps 0–8 — the actual runtime logic
- [refs/detect.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/refs/detect.md): manual type-detection path, used only when the hook verdict is ambiguous or absent
- [refs/commands.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/refs/commands.md): /wdym command handling (--init / --help / --status / --set-mode)
- [refs/categories.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/refs/categories.json): the type taxonomy — keyword/regex scoring the hook and skill read (user-editable)
- [refs/principles/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/refs/principles/principles-global.md): principle files, one per type (global always loaded, plus code/question/text-gen)
- [hooks/prompt-detect.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ndisisnd/wdym/main/hooks/prompt-detect.py): the UserPromptSubmit pre-scorer that emits the <prompt-detect> block
